changes.before: Draft Urgency Ordinance 819 proposed a 45-day moratorium for the May 27, 2026 hearing; its adoption remains unconfirmed. The September 16 San Gabriel Valley Tribune reports a first reading on August 26, unanimous adoption September 9 and an October 9, 2026 effective date for Ordinance 821. changes.after: Proposed Urgency Ordinance 819 was pulled and not considered on May 27, 2026 (regular minutes item 21A). Published September 9 regular minutes item 19C confirm second-reading adoption of Ordinance 821 adding Chapter 17.42 to prohibit data-center land uses citywide, within the unanimously approved consent calendar. These minutes establish the permanent-ban adoption, not that an adopted temporary moratorium was legally replaced. Authenticated operative text and publication remain unverified.
